name: Carecraft
tagline: One useful minute of practice a day.
worry: What do I say to a worried family?

free: Try every app before you pay
end.paidLine: MedLex, Carecraft and Lumen in one pass
end.before: 7 days free, then £29.99 for your first year. Founding price until 31 Jan 2027.

beats.say: The hardest moment on shift is not always clinical. Sometimes, it is the next sentence you say. To a frightened family. To a busy doctor. To the colleague taking over from you.
What do I say? How do I escalate without sounding unsure? Did my handover really make sense?
Breathe. These are skills, and skills can be practised. Carecraft has you.

beats.title: Daily scenario
beats.say: Every day, one moment from a working shift. Think first, then compare your reasoning. The feedback names the behaviour, and gives you one specific thing to try next.

beats.title: Learn
beats.say: Thirty short lessons for the work you do, from foundation to advanced. Read, practise and reflect, with your own notes beside every lesson. Or learn as a guided slideshow.

beats.title: See it
beats.say: Ninety illustrated guides you can zoom, save and share. Listen with intention. Explain with clarity. Make numbers mean something.

beats.title: Practise
beats.say: An animated handover shows the message in order. Spot the hand hygiene moment in a ward scene, with no time pressure. Watch, decide, reflect.

beats.title: Toolkit
beats.say: Build a clear handover step by step, with worked examples beside you. Situation, background, assessment, recommendation. Fictional practice drafts, never clinical records.

beats.title: Grow
beats.say: See the skills you have rehearsed, from communicating to escalating to wellbeing. It shows coverage, not a competence score.
Thirty lessons. Ninety visual guides. Twenty two practice activities.
Carecraft is free to start. The full app comes with the Crown Pass, with seven days free. One useful minute a day.
